query: INSERT INTO notifications(id,workspace_id,user_id,issue_id,kind,message,created_at,dedup_key) SELECT $1::uuid,$2,$3,$4::uuid,'deadline',$5::text,now(),$6::text WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=$2 AND user_id=$3) AND COALESCE((SELECT deadline FROM alert_preferences WHERE workspace_id=$2 AND user_id=$3),true) ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,dedup_key) DO NOTHING
